now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
now.step: In episode 4, Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help track the super soldier serum, and Zemo joins him and Sam in hunting the Flag Smashers.

proposed.happens_at: Zemo's breakout happens in #3, at his prison in Germany, before the trip to Madripoor; in #4 Sam, Bucky and Zemo hunt the Flag Smashers in Latvia, not Madripoor.

changes.evidence: Episode 3 summary: Barnes orchestrates a prison riot so Zemo escapes, then they travel to Madripoor; episode 4 takes place in Latvia (Karli's mother's funeral, the Dora Milaje fight).

now.title: VisionQuest#6
now.step: In episode 6, after lowering his firewall to retake his body, which lets Ultron escape, Vision reaches Madripoor with Lisa, fights off the Ten Rings with Tommy's help, and flees with him.

proposed: Vision and Lisa come for the captive Tommy, and the three fight off Ten Rings soldiers before fleeing the city.
changes.evidence: Episode 6 summary: Paladin brings Tommy to Madripoor to blackmail Vision and Lisa; Ten Rings soldiers attack; Tommy and Lisa help Vision, and they flee Madripoor.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#62
now.step: In episode 62, Fitz brings Simmons back from an alien planet, and the two finally come together.

proposed.happens_at: Fitz brings Simmons back from Maveth in #46; in #62 the two consummate their relationship on Earth, after seeking out Holden Radcliffe.

changes.evidence: Episode 2 (#46) summary: Fitz enters the portal and brings Simmons back. Episode 18 (#62, The Singularity) is set on Earth, ending with Fitz and Simmons consummating their relationship.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#54
now.step: In episode 54, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.

proposed: Coulson kills Ward at the portal, and the creature wearing Will's body takes Ward's instead and slips back to Earth.
changes.evidence: Episode 10 (#54, Maveth): Coulson kills Ward on the planet; Hive, which inhabited Daniels' body, secretly returns to Earth inhabiting Ward's body. Same entry as for leads 4, 5 and 6.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#66
now.step: In episode 66, Coulson kills Ward on Maveth to avenge Rosalind Price and helps stop Hive. Six months later, he is no longer Director.

proposed.happens_at: Coulson kills Ward on Maveth in #54 (see the entry proposed for that episode); in #66 Hive is stopped aboard a Quinjet in space above Earth, and the six-month jump is on Earth.

changes.evidence: Episode 10 (#54): Coulson kills Ward on Maveth. Episode 22 (#66, Ascension): Lincoln flies the Quinjet with the warhead into space, killing Hive; six months later Coulson is no longer director.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#46
now.step: In episode 46, the Kree Monolith pulls her to an alien planet, where she survives for months before Fitz saves her.

proposed: Fitz goes through the Monolith's portal, finds Simmons on the dark planet and brings her back.
changes.evidence: Episode 2 (#46, Purpose in the Machine): Fitz sends a flare through the portal, enters it himself, finds Simmons and brings her back as the Monolith is destroyed. (The Monolith takes her in #44.)

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#54
now.step: In episode 54, Coulson kills Ward on an alien planet.

proposed: Coulson kills Ward at the portal, and the creature wearing Will's body takes Ward's instead and slips back to Earth.
changes.evidence: Episode 10 (#54, Maveth): at the exit Coulson uses his prosthetic hand to kill Ward; Fitz destroys Daniels' body; Hive returns to Earth in Ward's body.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#54
now.step: In episode 54, Will dies on the planet, and the creature there wears his body.

proposed: Coulson kills Ward at the portal, and the creature wearing Will's body takes Ward's instead and slips back to Earth.
changes.evidence: Episode 10 (#54, Maveth): it is revealed Hive killed Daniels after Simmons escaped and now inhabits his body; Fitz burns it with a flare. Same entry as lead 4.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#54
now.step: In episode 54, Ward and Gideon Malick rebuild HYDRA to bring back its ancient master, the Inhuman Hive.

proposed: Coulson kills Ward at the portal, and the creature wearing Will's body takes Ward's instead and slips back to Earth.
changes.evidence: Episode 10 (#54, Maveth): Ward goes through the portal for Hydra to bring back Hive, which returns to Earth in Ward's body. Same entry as lead 4.

now: Frank stops at a roadside bar and ends up protecting a girl named Amy.
proposed: Frank stops at a roadside bar and ends up protecting a girl on the run.
changes.evidence: The girl is unnamed in episode 1, calls herself Rachel in episode 2, and only reveals her real name, Amy, in episode 4.

now.title: The Punisher S2#2
now.step: In episode 2, Beth spends a night with Frank, is shot in the bar fight, and is threatened by Pilgrim in the hospital.

proposed: The religious man hunting the girl visits Beth in the hospital and threatens her family until she gives up the name Frank used.
changes.evidence: Episode 2 summary: the religious man visits Beth in the Michigan hospital and threatens her family and friends, forcing her to reveal Pete's name. (The night with Frank and the bar shooting are episode 1, already covered.)
